title: 第476章 诸天神战仙帝成名第475章 谁让你用滚筒洗衣机洗猫的
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
第6章诸天神战，仙帝成名
是劫难，亦是机缘。
以三千大世界为首，无数中千世界为辅，亿万小世界如星砂散布其间，强行开启诸天混战。
各大界域的仙尊、道主，尽数被迫参战，以强伐弱。
界与界征伐，域与域吞并，互相抢掠世界本源。
胜者攫取资源，界位抬升，道运鼎盛，万灵受益。败者全域降格，天道崩离，大道消亡，沦为胜者的养料。
大千世界互相攻伐，亦或掠夺中千世界获取资源；中千世界也可向上或向下吞并，借此晋升；而小世界若有妖孽崛起，能在夹缝中夺得机缘，亦可升格。
一界之争，便是亿万生灵之命。所有厮杀掠夺的一切资源，最终尽数供养己方界域的世界本源，撑起一界万古荣光。
说起当初元煌仙帝姬煌真正成名，便是在那上一场诸天神战。
彼时天元界尚还不能稳坐三千大世界之首，只能算做三千大世界的中流。
诸界强敌窥伺，而姬煌以妖孽之姿，横空出世！
那一战，他横压诸天，斩落十数位异界道主，为天元掠回无数世界本源。
一举奠定天元大世界三千大世界之首的无上位格！
也正是那一战之后，他登临绝巅，加冕天元帝位，名震万古。
仙庭凌霄之主。
天元诸天之尊。
那时的天元天道，有多激赏这位凌霄道主？
尤甚现在对云擎的“谄媚”百倍。
可惜，成也元煌仙帝，败也元煌仙帝。
天元因他登顶诸天，后来也因他撕裂天地，而从三千大世界之首一步步衰败跌落。

三界分裂，九天不合，十地残缺。
万般乱象根源，亦是出自眼前这位疯绝诸天的仙帝之手。
天元天道对此獠的心情，实在复杂极了。
天外天，凌霄宝殿内。
天元天道的意志萦绕在侧，回忆着当年从未想过的辉煌。
诸方世界的天道总是或凭冥冥中的意志，亦或是有意，不断一代一代凝聚着所谓“气运之子”。
当然，参考叶天辰，并不是把所有气运一股脑的投注下来，就能收获一个最强者，大世界的天道不到生死存亡之际，绝不会把鸡蛋放在一个篮子，呃一个“天命之子”身上，这里面有着很复杂的法则机制。
天元天道不愿回想它当年是怎么这样那样无意中出了一个大的。
第6章诸天神战，仙帝成名
于是说回正题。
只有最强者，才能替一界掠夺最高的资源。
若元煌仙帝不是个性情乖戾、偏执疯癫的疯子，天元天道甘愿永世为其摇旗呐喊、俯首称臣。
天天给他当狗腿。
可过往浩劫历历在目，爱恨交织、敬畏掺杂。
元煌仙帝很强。
content_en:
Chapter 6: Battle between gods and gods, the Immortal Emperor becomes famous
It's a disaster, but it's also an opportunity.
Headed by the three thousand big worlds, supplemented by countless middle thousand worlds, billions of small worlds are scattered among them like star sand, forcibly starting a melee among the heavens.
Immortals and Taoist masters from all major realms were all forced to participate in the war, using the strong to defeat the weak.
Conquests were made between realms, regions were annexed, and the origin of the world was plundered from each other.
The winner seizes resources, rises in status, flourishes in fortune, and benefits all souls. The loser's entire domain is degraded, the heavenly way collapses, and the great road dies, becoming the nourishment of the winner.
The big thousand worlds attack each other, or plunder the middle thousand worlds to obtain resources; the middle thousand worlds can also be annexed upward or downward to be promoted; and if a monster rises in the small world, it can seize opportunities in the cracks and can be promoted.
The struggle of one realm is the fate of billions of living beings. All the resources that were fought and plundered will eventually support the origin of the world in one's own realm and support the eternal glory of the realm.
Speaking of the original Yuanhuang Immortal Emperor Ji Huang's real fame, it was during the battle between gods and gods.
At that time, the Tianyuan Realm was not yet firmly at the top of the Three Thousand Worlds, and could only be regarded as the middle stream of the Three Thousand Worlds.
Powerful enemies from all over the world were watching, and Ji Huang appeared like a monster!
In that battle, he overwhelmed the heavens, killed dozens of Taoist masters from other worlds, and regained the origin of countless worlds for Tianyuan.
In one fell swoop, he established his supreme status as the leader of the three thousand worlds in Tianyuan World!
It was also after that battle that he reached the top and was crowned Tianyuan Emperor, becoming famous throughout the ages.
The Lord of Immortal Court Lingxiao.
The lord of all heavens in Tianyuan.
How much did Tianyuan Tiandao admire this Taoist Master Lingxiao at that time?
Especially now, he is "flattery" to Yun Qing a hundred times.
It's a pity that Immortal Emperor Yuanhuang succeeded and Immortal Emperor Yuanhuang failed.
Because of him, Tianyuan ascended to the top of the heavens, and later because of him, he tore apart the heavens and the earth, and gradually declined from the top of the three thousand worlds.
The three realms are divided, the nine heavens are at odds, and the ten lands are incomplete.
The root of all chaos is also the hand of the Immortal Emperor in front of him who is crazy about all the heavens.
Tianyuan Tiandao's mood towards this beast is really complicated.
Beyond the sky, inside the Lingxiao Palace.
The will of Tianyuan Tiandao lingered beside him, recalling the glory that he had never thought of back then.
The way of heaven in all worlds always condenses the so-called "sons of destiny" from generation to generation, either by implicit will or intentionally.
Of course, referring to Ye Tianchen, it is not that you can harvest the strongest person by betting all your luck. The heaven of the big world will never put eggs in one basket, uh, on a "child of destiny" until the moment of life and death. There are very complicated laws and mechanisms in this.
Tianyuan Tiandao doesn't want to recall how it accidentally produced a big one in this way.
Chapter 6: Battle between gods and gods, the Immortal Emperor becomes famous
So back to the topic.
Only the strongest can plunder the highest resources for a world.
If Immortal Emperor Yuanhuang was not a surly, paranoid lunatic, Tianyuan Tiandao would be willing to cheer for him and bow his head forever.
Being his dogleg every day.
But the past catastrophes are still vivid in our minds, and we are mixed with love, hate, and awe.
Immortal Emperor Yuanhuang is very strong.
